lines.en: label sportswars11:
scene noonsky
: Aaaah! How is the sun already starting to set?! We’re only five contests in! What time even is it right now?!
lines.zh: : 啊啊啊！太阳怎么已经开始落山了？！我们才比了五项！现在到底几点了？！

lines.en: : Have you been so absorbed in these ridiculous games that you completely missed the end-of-day bell?
lines.zh: : 你是不是沉浸在这些荒唐的比赛里，连放学铃都完全没听见？

lines.en: : Yes. Yes, I have. But this is something I should be forgiven for based on how complicated all of these games have been! And increasingly hard to set up too.
lines.zh: : 是。是的，我确实是。不过看在这些比赛有多复杂的份上，这点应该值得原谅吧！而且布置起来也越来越费劲了。

lines.en: : Both of those things are your fault entirely and they are not going to make me feel bad for you.
lines.zh: : 这两件事全都怪你自己，而且它们不会让我对你有半点同情。

lines.en: : Okay! Listen up, girls! We’ve only got three more outdoor competitions to get through before we can head back to the rooms I booked for us tonight.
lines.zh: : 好了！听好了，姑娘们！我们只要再搞定三项户外比赛，就能回我今晚给咱们订的房间了。

lines.en: : You mean the rooms {i}I{/i} booked for us tonight.
lines.zh: : 你是说，{i}我{/i}今晚给咱们订的房间吧。

lines.en: : Nah. You’re part of the 1%% who’s withholding the country’s wealth from hard-working people like me teaching students in exchange for pennies. Your money is {i}my{/i} money.
lines.zh: : 不。你属于那 1%%，把国家的财富从像我这样辛勤劳动、为了几个铜板教书育人的人手里攥着不放。你的钱就是{i}我的{/i}钱。

lines.en: : Technically speaking, my money is my family’s money. And it was obtained through generations and generations of-
lines.zh: : 严格来说，我的钱是我家的钱。而且是一代又一代——

lines.en: : Bubble wrap and other things. Doesn’t matter. What does {i}matter{/i} is the fact that we’ve gotta kick things into overdrive so we can finish up before it gets dark!
lines.zh: : 靠气泡膜什么的攒起来的。不重要。{i}重要{/i}的是我们得全力加速，趁天黑之前把比赛搞完！

lines.en: : And what better way to do that than with a good ole’ fashioned relay race?! No frills added.
lines.zh: : 还有什么比一场老派传统的接力赛更合适的？！不加任何花活儿。

lines.en: : Based on the rest of the day, I’m a little reluctant to believe there won’t be any “frills.” But hey! I’m ready to go. Especially since I’ve been banned from competing in death ball.
lines.zh: : 基于今天前头的状况，我可不太敢相信会没有“花活儿”。不过嘿！我准备好了。尤其是既然我已经被禁止参加死亡球了。

lines.en: : Sorry, Ayane. But without any idea of what death ball is yet, we figured it would be safest for everyone if you just went back inside for that.
lines.zh: : 抱歉啊，Ayane。但在还没搞清楚死亡球到底是什么之前，我们觉得为了大家的安全起见，那一项你就回屋里待着吧。

lines.en: : Cowards! Face your fears!
lines.zh: : 胆小鬼！直面你们的恐惧啊！

lines.en: : Now, if all girls competing in the relay race could make their way to the center circle, we can-
lines.zh: : 那么，参加接力赛的各位女生请到中圈集合，我们就可以——

lines.en: scene relayrace1
: Oh. You’re already there. Neat.
lines.zh: : 哦。你们已经在那儿了。挺好。

lines.en: : It’ll be a pleasure competing against you again, Miku. Here’s to hoping I’ll perform better this time.
lines.zh: : 很高兴能再和你同场竞技，Miku。希望这次我能表现得好一点。

lines.en: : Here’s to hopin’ ‘yer boobs don’t fly off and whack one of us in the face.
lines.zh: : 那我就希望你的奶子别飞出来甩到我们谁脸上。

lines.en: scene relayrace2
: Here’s to hoping they {i}do.{/i}
lines.zh: : 我倒希望它们{i}飞出来{/i}。

lines.en: : Here’s to hoping that one day, my peers will be able to see me as more than a walking pair of breasts.
lines.zh: : 那我就希望有朝一日，同龄人能把我当成不只是一对会走路的胸来看。

lines.en: : Gotta fly before ya can walk, Touka. That’s what David Beckham always says.
lines.zh: : 先得会飞才能会走嘛，Touka。David Beckham 一直这么说的。

lines.en: : You know what else David Beckham always says, Miku?
lines.zh: : 你知道 David Beckham 还总说什么吗，Miku？

lines.en: : “Hi. I’m David Beckham.”
lines.zh: : “嗨。我是 David Beckham。”

lines.en: : Right. But also, that floor two is going down and floor one is going to come out victorious, {i}bitches.{/i}
lines.zh: : 对。不过他还说，二层要完蛋了，一层会取得胜利，{i}婊子们{/i}。

lines.en: : I’m curious about the context in which he would say something like that.
lines.zh: : 我挺好奇他是在什么情境下说出这种话的。

lines.en: : And {i}I’m{/i} curious about why you three think you stand a chance. We have {i}Miku{/i} on our team. She’s the fastest girl in the school. Probably.
lines.zh: : {i}我{/i}也挺好奇你们三个凭什么觉得自己有胜算。我们队里有 {i}Miku{/i}。她是全校跑得最快的女生。大概吧。

lines.en: : It’s not like I’ve measured, but it’s probably true.
lines.zh: : 我又没量过，不过大概是真的。

lines.en: scene relayrace3
: Yeah, but this is a {i}relay{/i} race. We {i}all{/i} have to participate. Which just means that we stand a chance so long as we beat you and Ayane by enough.
lines.zh: : 是啊，可这是{i}接力{/i}赛。我们{i}都{/i}得下场。也就是说，只要我们把你和 Ayane 甩开够多，我们就有机会。

lines.en: : And I feel quite good about our chances this time as I have never seen you participate in anything athletic, Chika.
lines.zh: : 而且我对这次的机会挺有信心的，毕竟我从来没见你参加过任何体育活动，Chika。

lines.en: : I was chosen for this contest for a reason, Touka.
lines.zh: : 我被选来参加这个项目是有原因的，Touka。

lines.en: : You were chosen for the cheer competition for a reason as well and that didn’t really pan out the way it was supposed to. So here’s hoping this time it does, I guess!
lines.zh: : 你被选去参加啦啦队比赛也是“有原因的”，结果也没按预想的发展嘛。所以这次就祈祷能成吧，我猜！

lines.en: scene relayrace4
: That was a fluke. If we were given more than a few minutes to prepare, Rin and I would have wiped the floor with them.
lines.zh: : 那是个意外。要是能给我们多于几分钟的准备时间，我和 Rin 早就把她们打得落花流水了。

lines.en: : Will that be your excuse when you lose this time as well?
lines.zh: : 这次要是也输了，这还会是你的借口吗？

lines.en: : We ain’t gonna {i}need{/i} an excuse this time, Kirin. By the time we’re done with ya, you’ll be wishin’ you got chosen for death ball instead.
lines.zh: : 这次我们{i}用不着{/i}借口，Kirin。等我们收拾完你，你会巴不得自己被选去打死亡球的。

lines.en: : I know it’s not what we discussed, but do you mind if I run first, Touka? Then you could move to second and we can have Kirin as our anchor since she’s the only one of us who actually plays sports.
lines.zh: : 我知道这跟我们商量好的不一样，但我跑第一棒行吗，Touka？然后你挪到第二棒，让 Kirin 压轴，反正我们仨里只有她是真正在搞运动的。

lines.en: : For the millionth time, so do I. But yes, I have no qualm with that change as it will allow me to compete against Ayane.
lines.zh: : 我都说第一百万次了，我也在搞运动。不过行，这么换我没意见，因为这样我就能跟 Ayane 对上了。

lines.en: scene relayrace5
: Wait, how do you guys know the order we’re running in?
lines.zh: : 等等，你们怎么知道我们的棒次顺序？

lines.en: : Miku posted it on her Instagram.
lines.zh: : Miku 发到她 Instagram 上了。

lines.en: : Yeah, that tracks.
lines.zh: : 嗯，这倒是在理。

lines.en: : Ha. {i}Tracks.{/i} Nice.
: So, I guess it’s you and me first, Noriko?
lines.zh: : 那么，看来第一棒是我和你了，Noriko？

lines.en: : Sure is! And if I beat you, you must grant me Yumi’s hand in marriage. That is my condition.
lines.zh: : 没错！而且如果我赢了你，你就得把 Yumi 的手许配给我。这是我的条件。

lines.en: : Can I have your sister if I win?
lines.zh: : 那我赢了的话，能把你姐姐给我吗？

lines.en: : Sure, so long as you can pry her off of Sensei.
lines.zh: : 行啊，只要你能把她从 Sensei 身上扒下来。

lines.en: scene relayrace6
: If I can {i}what?{/i}
lines.zh: : 只要我能{i}什么{/i}？

lines.en: scene relayrace7
: Ngh!
: Imani! Can you please stop with the whistle?!
lines.zh: : Imani！你能不能别吹哨子了？！

lines.en: : Aaaah, fuck! I’m sorry again, Miku! I was just trying to restore some order and forgot about your thing. I’ll do better.
lines.zh: : 啊啊啊，操！又对不起了，Miku！我只是想维持一下秩序，忘了你有那毛病。我会注意的。

lines.en: scene relayrace8
: I’m good! No worries!
lines.zh: : 我没事！别担心！

lines.en: : Noriko-
lines.zh: : Noriko——

lines.en: : Let’s hold off on having any more discussions for now. Imani already told us we have to kick it into overdrive and I’m pretty sure that whistle was her telling us to line up.
lines.zh: : 我们暂时先别聊了。Imani 说了要全力加速，而且我很确定那声哨子是在叫我们排队。

lines.en: scene black
: Oh. Yeah. Yeah, you’re right.
lines.zh: : 哦。对。对，你说得对。

lines.en: : Come on, Noriko! Show me what you’ve got!
lines.zh: : 来吧，Noriko！让我看看你的本事！

lines.en: : Sure! Just have to reach into my waistband and-
lines.zh: : 好啊！我只要把手伸进腰带里——

lines.en: : Are you really going to run with your knife tucked into your fucking bloomers?!
lines.zh: : 你真的要揣着那把刀塞在裤衩里跑步吗？！

lines.en: : Of course! Where else would I put it?
lines.zh: : 当然！不然我还能放哪儿？

lines.en: scene noonsky
: Ladies and gentlemen! The rules of the contest are simple! For real this time!
lines.zh: : 女士们先生们！比赛规则很简单！这次是真的！

lines.en: : Each team has been given a colored baton that they’ll need to hang onto throughout the duration of the race.
lines.zh: : 每支队伍都拿到一根彩色接力棒，全程都要牢牢拿着。

lines.en: : They’ll run in pairs of two, handing off the baton as they go, and the contest will come to an end once either Miku or Kirin makes it through the finish line!
lines.zh: : 两人一组接力，边跑边交接棒，等 Miku 或 Kirin 任意一人冲过终点线，比赛就结束！

lines.en: : As always, the reward will be one point! If floor two wins, they’ll tie the contest at three points apiece. And, if floor one wins, they’ll extend their lead to four points over two!
lines.zh: : 老规矩，奖励是一分！如果二层赢，双方三比三打平。如果一层赢，他们就把领先优势扩大到四比二！

lines.en: : Noriko! Chika! Are you ready?!
lines.zh: : Noriko！Chika！准备好了吗？！

lines.en: : Ready!
lines.zh: : 准备好了！

lines.en: : Yup!
: Then! Wakana, if you would do the honors. But without the gun so we don’t scare Miku again.
lines.zh: : 那么！Wakana，请你来发令。但别用发令枪，免得又吓到 Miku。

lines.en: : Bang.
: Do...Do we run now? I don’t know if that means-
lines.zh: : 我们……我们现在跑吗？我不知道这是不是意味着——

lines.en: : Ngh!
: And with that, Chika’s off!
lines.zh: : 就这样，Chika 冲出去了！

lines.en: scene relayrace9
: Shit!
: Think you can get a head start on me, do you?! I’ve gotten straight A’s in PE my whole life!
lines.zh: : 以为能抢我先跑是吧？！我体育从小的成绩就一直是 A！

lines.en: : That isn’t impressive! All you have to do is show up and participate to get an A in PE!
lines.zh: : 这有什么了不起！体育课只要到场、参与一下就能拿 A！

lines.en: : Sure! But you could say the same thing about sociology and people still get degrees in that for some reason.
lines.zh: : 是没错！可社会学也一样啊，不知道为什么还有人能拿那个学位。

lines.en: : We don’t even have that class here! Now, shut up and run!
lines.zh: : 我们学校压根没那门课！现在，闭嘴，跑你的！

lines.en: scene relayrace10
: Wakana! Any early impression of the race based on the skill and shape of our contestants?
lines.zh: : Wakana！根据选手们的技术和体型，你对这场比赛有什么初步印象吗？

lines.en: : No.
lines.zh: : 没有。

lines.en: : Well, luckily for you, I’ve prepared stat and fact sheets for both of them to fill the dead air in the broadcast since running isn’t really an activity that’s easy to just silently watch!
lines.zh: : 嗯，算你走运，我给她们俩都准备了数据和资料卡，用来填广播里的冷场——毕竟跑步这运动，干看着不出声实在太难了！

lines.en: : I do hope that you acquired all of this apparent information legally.
lines.zh: : 我真心希望你搞到的这些信息都是合法渠道来的。

lines.en: : It was legal-ish! I just had to go spelunking, in a sense.
lines.zh: : 算是合法吧！某种意义上，我只是去探了个洞。

lines.en: : Please tell me you did not jump into the sinkhole.
lines.zh: : 你可别告诉我你跳进那个天坑里了。

lines.en: : Okay! I won’t! But what I {i}will{/i} tell you is that Noriko has gotten straight A’s in {i}every{/i} subject throughout her entire life! It's not just PE!
lines.zh: : 好的！我不说！但我{i}要{/i}告诉你的是，Noriko 从小到大{i}每一科{/i}都拿 A！可不只是体育！

lines.en: : Does that help with her running at all? Probably not. But it’s still a cool thing to know!
lines.zh: : 这对她跑步有帮助吗？大概没有。不过知道了还是挺酷的！

lines.en: : What’s my fact, Imani?! I want a fact too!
lines.zh: : 我的资料是什么，Imani？！我也要一条！

lines.en: : Let’s see...Chika...Chika...ah! Here we go! Chika Chosokabe has an undefeated record of 17-0 when it comes to boxing old people!
lines.zh: : 我看看……Chika……Chika……啊！找到了！Chika Chosokabe 在拳击老年人这件事上保持着 17 胜 0 负的不败战绩！

lines.en: scene relayrace11
: I’ve never boxed an old person! Let alone seventeen of them!
lines.zh: : 我从来没拳击过老年人！更别说十七个了！

lines.en: : And I got a B in AP English once, so I’m pretty sure she’s just making these things up as she goes. But hey! Beating up seventeen old people is way more impressive than straight A’s!
lines.zh: : 而且我有一次 AP 英语拿了 B，所以我敢肯定她是在现编。不过嘿！暴打十七个老人可比全 A 酷多了！

lines.en: : It helped that they were all using walkers.
lines.zh: : 而且他们都用助行器，这一点帮了大忙。

lines.en: scene relayrace12
: Chika, how could you?!
lines.zh: : Chika，你怎么能这样？！

lines.en: : I couldn’t! Well...I mean I {i}could!{/i} But I {i}wouldn’t!{/i}
lines.zh: : 我没有！好吧……我是说我{i}能做到{/i}！但我{i}不会{/i}做的！

lines.en: : But you did!
lines.zh: : 可你做了！

lines.en: : Only hypothetically!
lines.zh: : 只是假设而已！

lines.en: : Noriko! Stop talking and save your breath! I want to win this!
lines.zh: : Noriko！别说话了，省点力气！我想赢这场！

lines.en: scene noonsky
: It don’t matter {i}what{/i} strategy y’all use, Kirin! Ya ain’t got a chance against me and Ayane! Right, Ayane?!
lines.zh: : 你们用{i}什么{/i}战术都没用，Kirin！你对我和 Ayane 一点机会都没有！对吧，Ayane？！

lines.en: : Right! And even though I’ve barely exercised at all lately, I still know I can do this! Egg Time Madness warmed me up!
lines.zh: : 对！虽然我最近几乎没怎么锻炼，但我知道我能行！抛蛋狂潮已经给我热好身了！

lines.en: : So sad we lost Sana, though.
lines.zh: : 不过我们把 Sana 给弄丢了，真让人难过。

lines.en: : I’m still...I’m still right here...
lines.zh: : 我还……我还在这儿呢……

lines.en: : Oh! What’s this?! Could this final burst of speed from Noriko Nakayama be enough to- yes! She’s the first one to hand off the baton! And with Chika just a second behind!
lines.zh: : 哦！这是什么？！Noriko Nakayama 这最后一段冲刺够不够——够了！她是第一个交接棒的！Chika 只落后一秒！

lines.en: scene relayrace13
: Things are really heating up now, folks!
lines.zh: : 各位，局势现在真的白热化了！

lines.en: : Hey! You’re not supposed to be faster than me! I’m built way more aerodynamically than you! {i}And{/i} I’m fit!
lines.zh: : 嘿！你不该比我快！我的身材比你有流线型多了！{i}而且{/i}我体能好！

lines.en: : You may be able to defeat me in hand-to-hand combat, but I’ve spent at least an hour on the treadmill every day since I was eight years old! Both my stamina {i}and{/i} speed are exceptional!
lines.zh: : 你是能在近身格斗里打败我，但我从八岁起每天至少在跑步机上待一小时！我的耐力{i}和{/i}速度都出类拔萃！

lines.en: : Her stamina’s only good cause she’s been gettin’ frisky with those damn horses of hers for an hour every day too!
lines.zh: : 她耐力好只是因为她每天还要跟她那几匹该死的马欢闹一个小时！

lines.en: scene relayrace14
: Stop being disgusting! The hour I spend with my horses each day is typically for maintenance as opposed to leisure!
lines.zh: : 别说得这么恶心！我每天和马待的那一小时通常是做保养，不是娱乐！

lines.en: : That somehow makes it sound even more gross!
lines.zh: : 你这么一说反倒更恶心了！

lines.en: : Why is everyone in this class so perverted?!
lines.zh: : 为什么这个班上的每个人都这么变态？！

lines.en: : I blame Sensei. He was a bad influence on us.
lines.zh: : 都怪 Sensei。他把我们带坏了。

lines.en: : But you’ve always been like this.
lines.zh: : 可你一直都是这样的啊。

lines.en: : Yeah, but now I’m worse.
lines.zh: : 是啊，但现在我更严重了。

lines.en: : Wakana! Want to give us a few facts about-
lines.zh: : Wakana！要不要也讲几点关于——

lines.en: : No.
lines.zh: : 不要。

lines.en: : Okay! Looks like it’ll fall on me again, then!
lines.zh: : 好吧！看来又得我自己来了！

lines.en: : Just leave my horses out of it, please!
lines.zh: : 求你别把我的马扯进来！

lines.en: : Understood! But only because your snipers will assassinate me if I don’t.
lines.zh: : 明白！不过只是因为如果我不答应，你的狙击手会把我干掉。

lines.en: : Even if you didn’t {i}have{/i} any snipers though, it wouldn’t protect me since you’re a three time American sumo champion.
lines.zh: : 不过就算你{i}没有{/i}狙击手，也保护不了我，因为你可是三届美国相扑冠军。

lines.en: : Sumo is nothing to scoff at! Those are some of the strongest men in the world! They could tear me to pieces if they wanted!
lines.zh: : 相扑可不容小觑！那些人可是世界上最强壮的男人！他们要是想，能把我撕成碎片！

lines.en: scene relayrace15
: You know, I think Sensei might have made me worse as well because I definitely interpreted that in a way I wasn’t supposed to.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗，我觉得 Sensei 大概也把我也带坏了，因为我刚才肯定是以一种不该有的方式理解了那句话。

lines.en: : Every single one of you is sickeningly lewd!
lines.zh: : 你们每一个都淫秽得令人作呕！

lines.en: : You’ll get there one day too, Touka.
lines.zh: : 你有一天也会变成这样的，Touka。

lines.en: : Yeah, maybe all those sumo guys’ll help ya.
lines.zh: : 是啊，说不定那些相扑壮汉能帮上你的忙。

lines.en: : For those of you at home wondering whether or not Ayane will be able to catch up, you’ll be able to rest easy with this helpful statistic — she has never once before lost a race!
lines.zh: : 正在家里收看、心里嘀咕 Ayane 能不能追上的观众们，有这个有用的数据你们就放心吧——她从来没有输过一场比赛！

lines.en: scene relayrace16
: Hey, that one’s true!
lines.zh: : 嘿，这条是真的！

lines.en: : How many races have you been in?!
lines.zh: : 你一共参加过几场比赛啊？！

lines.en: : She’s been in 4,672,710! Most of which have taken place overseas alongside her cross country captain, Mike Tyson.
lines.zh: : 她参加过 4,672,710 场！其中大多数还是在海外，和她的越野跑队长 Mike Tyson 一起。

lines.en: : That one’s not.
lines.zh: : 这条是假的。

lines.en: scene noonsky
: Aaah! I’ve had enough of this!
lines.zh: : 啊啊啊！我受够了！

lines.en: : Wha- Touka?! Don’t speed up! We won’t be able to talk anymore!
lines.zh: : 什——Touka？！别加速！这样我们就没法聊天了！

lines.en: : That’s the whole point!
lines.zh: : 我要的就是这个效果！

lines.en: : Wow, look at this! Once again, floor two is taking the lead in the later half of-
lines.zh: : 哇，瞧瞧！二层又一次在后半程取得了领先——

lines.en: : Ack!?!
: Forget that, folks! It looks like Ayane’s taken a tumble!
lines.zh: : 各位，那个先不管！看起来 Ayane 摔了一跤！

lines.en: : Kirin!
lines.zh: : Kirin！

lines.en: : Got it!
lines.zh: : 接住了！

lines.en: : And Kirin’s already off! How is the first floor going to come back from this?!
lines.zh: : Kirin 已经冲出去了！一层要怎么从这种局面里翻盘？！

lines.en: : Ayane! Get the heck up! It ain’t break time yet, ya friggin’ pansy!
lines.zh: : Ayane！快他妈爬起来！还没到休息时间呢，你这个该死的软蛋！

lines.en: : Phbhbhbt! So much sand...in my mouth! Permission to throw baton?!
lines.zh: : 呸呸呸！好多沙子……进我嘴里了！申请把接力棒扔过去？！

lines.en: : There is no way that can be in line with the rules of-
lines.zh: : 这不可能符合……的规则吧

lines.en: : Permission granted!
lines.zh: : 批准！

lines.en: : What?!
lines.zh: : 什么？！

lines.en: : Egg Time Madness!
lines.zh: : 抛蛋狂潮！

lines.en: scene relayrace17
: {i}Egg Time Madness!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}抛蛋狂潮！{/i}

lines.en: : Hah! Hah! Hah! Hah!
lines.zh: : 哈！哈！哈！哈！

lines.en: : Go, Kirin! Go! Fight! You’ve got this!
lines.zh: : 加油，Kirin！冲！干！你行的！

lines.en: : Stop, Kirin! Stop! There’s a dick behind you! Don’t you want to go, like, spit on it or something?!
lines.zh: : 停下，Kirin！停下！你身后有根鸡巴！你就不想过去……比如说，往上面吐口口水什么的吗？！

lines.en: : Chosokabe. Detention next Friday.
lines.zh: : Chosokabe。下周五留堂。

lines.en: : What?! Imani! Miss Watabe just gave me detention and I have work that day!
lines.zh: : 什么？！Imani！Watabe 老师刚给了我留堂处分，可我那天要上班！

lines.en: : You have {i}what{/i} that day?
lines.zh: : 你那天有{i}什么{/i}？

lines.en: : Oh, did I say “work?” I meant...a party. I don't have a job. And if I do, it's definitely not one where I have to wear a somewhat skimpy maid outfit and pretend to flirt with people.
lines.zh: : 哦，我说的是“上班”吗？我意思是……一个派对。我没有工作。就算有，也绝对不是那种要穿有点暴露的女仆装、假装跟客人调情的工作。

lines.en: : Ugh, you too?
lines.zh: : 呃，你也这样？

lines.en: : Detention sounds like a you-problem, Chika! I’m too busy informing the people that Kirin can type 165 words per minute and has a secret collection of Pringles cans that she keeps underneath her bed.
lines.zh: : 留堂听起来是你自己的问题，Chika！我忙着向观众播报呢——Kirin 每分钟能打 165 个字，还偷偷在床底下藏了一堆品客薯片罐。

lines.en: : The only thing...I keep under my bed...is victory!
lines.zh: : 我藏在床底下的……只有胜利！

lines.en: : Either she’s lying right now or she has given her vibrator a very peculiar name.
lines.zh: : 要么她现在在撒谎，要么她给自己的按摩棒起了个非常特别的名字。

lines.en: : Ew. She keeps it under the bed? Why not hide it beneath her panties in the top drawer like a real girl?
lines.zh: : 噫。她把它藏在床底下？为什么不跟正常女孩一样，把它藏在最上层抽屉的内裤下面？

lines.en: : But then no one would ever accidentally see it and have to think about her using it on herself.
lines.zh: : 可那样就不会有人不小心看见，然后被迫去想象她自己用它的样子了。

lines.en: : Nakayama. One more word and you can join Chosokabe on Friday.
lines.zh: : Nakayama。再多说一个字，你周五就能跟 Chosokabe 作伴了。

lines.en: : Nepotism! This is nepotism! Noriko should have detention too! We can be bad girls together!
lines.zh: : 任人唯亲！这就是任人唯亲！Noriko 也该留堂！我们可以一起当坏女孩！

lines.en: : Can you two...shut up?! You’re...ruining my focus!
lines.zh: : 你们两个……能闭嘴吗？！你们……在分散我的注意力！

lines.en: scene relayrace18
: Hiya, slowpoke!
lines.zh: : 嗨呀，慢吞吞的家伙！

lines.en: : Oh, god fucking damn it!
lines.zh: : 哦，我操他妈的！

lines.en: : What were ya sayin’ about “focus” just now? Must’a missed the first part since I was in the zone.
lines.zh: : 你刚才说“注意力”来着？我进入状态了，前半句没听清。

lines.en: : How the fuck did you catch up so quickly?! Ayane ate shit! We should’ve had this in the bag!
lines.zh: : 你他妈怎么追上来这么快？！Ayane 摔了个狗吃屎！我们本来应该稳赢的！

lines.en: : The only bag you’ll be havin’ is...the one that...the one that losers get after...after they lose!
lines.zh: : 你能拿到的袋子只有……那个……就是输家输了以后拿到的那个袋子！

lines.en: : That’s not even a thing!
lines.zh: : 根本就没有这种东西！

lines.en: : Well it is now! Because that’s the bag you’ll be-
lines.zh: : 现在有了！因为那就是你会拿到的袋子——

lines.en: : Eyes forward, girls! You’re approaching the twist!
lines.zh: : 姑娘们，眼睛看前面！你们快到“转折”了！

lines.en: scene relayrace19
: What?! What kind of {i}twist{/i} did you-
lines.zh: : 什么？！你说的{i}转折{/i}是什——

lines.en: scene relayrace20
: Wha-
: How did none of us see this until now?!
lines.zh: : 我们怎么到现在才看见这玩意儿？！

lines.en: : Ayane! Get ‘yer damn banana off my track! This ain’t funny anymore!
lines.zh: : Ayane！把你那该死的香蕉从我的跑道上挪开！这一点都不好笑了！

lines.en: : It’s not mine this time, I swear! It’s Imani’s! She said “no frills” but this is clearly a frill!
lines.zh: : 这次真不是我的，我发誓！是 Imani 的！她说了“不加花活儿”，但这明摆着就是个花活儿！

lines.en: : MWAHAHAHAHAHA! IT’S BANANA TIME!
lines.zh: : 哇哈哈哈哈哈！香蕉时间到了！

lines.en: : God...you’ve completely lost it, haven’t you?
lines.zh: : 天哪……你已经彻底疯了，是吧？

lines.en: : That banana is simply too large! They’ll never be able to get around it!
lines.zh: : 那根香蕉实在太大了！她们绝对绕不过去！

lines.en: : That’s not true. It’ll probably get sucked into the gaping black hole that is Kirin’s vagina the second she tries to climb over it.
lines.zh: : 那可不一定。Kirin 一爬上去，它大概就会被她那如同黑洞般大张的阴道给吸进去。

lines.en: : That’d be extremely impressive, not gonna lie.
lines.zh: : 说实话，那可就厉害大发了。

lines.en: : What do we do now? We can’t advance. The banana is just too large.
lines.zh: : 现在我们怎么办？过不去了。那根香蕉实在太大了。

lines.en: scene relayrace21
: Hah...
: Miku? What are you thinking?...
lines.zh: : Miku？你在想什么？……

lines.en: : It looks like...I’m gonna have to jump it.
lines.zh: : 看来……我只能跳过去了。

lines.en: scene relayrace22
: But it’s such a large banana! Just look at all the text surrounding it! You’ll never make it out alive!
lines.zh: : 可那是好大一根香蕉啊！光看看它周围围着多少字就知道！你绝对会没命的！

lines.en: : Ya know...somethin’ else David Beckham always said was “No banana's too large if ya just believe in yourself.”
lines.zh: : 你知道吗……David Beckham 还总说：“只要相信自己，就没有太大的香蕉。”

lines.en: : That’s very inspiring and I’m inclined to agree, but still! You’ll die!
lines.zh: : 这话很励志，我也挺认同的，可是！你会死的！

lines.en: scene relayrace23
: But at least I’ll die the hero of the first floor!
lines.zh: : 但至少我会作为一层的英雄而死！

lines.en: : Miku!
lines.zh: : Miku！

lines.en: scene black
: Nooooooooooo!!!!!!!!!!!!!
scene relayrace24
: Why didn’t either of us just tell her to walk around it?
lines.zh: : 我们俩怎么就没人直接叫她绕过去呢？

lines.en: : Beats me. But it looks like she figured it out on her own in the end.
lines.zh: : 谁知道呢。不过看样子她最后自己想明白了。

lines.en: : Congratulations, Miku. You’ve passed the hidden ninth obstacle — giant banana. You can finally rest.
lines.zh: : 恭喜你，Miku。你通过了隐藏的第九关——巨型香蕉。你终于可以休息了。

lines.en: : Oh, and you’ve also managed to win the relay race and earn another point for the first floor. The score is now four to two.
lines.zh: : 哦，另外你还赢了接力赛，为一层再拿一分。现在比分是四比二。

lines.en: : All in a day’s work, Miss Imani. Ain’t no banana too big for Miku Maruyama.
lines.zh: : 举手之劳，Imani 老师。对 Miku Maruyama 来说，没有太大的香蕉。

lines.en: : As proud as I am, I am also your teacher and I do not want you to say things like that to me. Especially in front of Wakana since she’s growing more agitated with me by the day.
lines.zh: : 虽然我很骄傲，但我也是你的老师，我不想你对我说这种话。尤其是在 Wakana 面前，她对我越来越不耐烦了。

lines.en: : I think it’s more so the fact that you’re becoming worryingly unstable and that I may have to commit you soon.
lines.zh: : 我觉得更主要的原因是你越来越不稳定，到了令人担忧的地步，我可能很快就得把你送进精神病院了。

lines.en: : See what I mean? She’s so angry now. It’s like she doesn’t even love me anymore.
lines.zh: : 看到没？她现在可生气了。就好像她已经不爱我了一样。

lines.en: scene relayrace25
: {i}Bold of you to assume I’ve ever loved you in the first place with how difficult you make my life on a daily basis.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你天天把我的生活搞得这么难，居然还敢假设我一开始爱过你。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}She says, despite being allowed to go home and still electing to spend her time here with me.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}她嘴上这么说，明明可以回家了，却还是选择把时间花在这儿陪我。{/i}

lines.en: scene relayrace26
: {i}Baton please, Miku. I’ve gotta go find Rika before she tries to escape her ultimate duty.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}接力棒给我吧，Miku。我得去找 Rika，免得她想逃避她的终极职责。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Ultimate duty?...{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}终极职责？……{/i}

lines.en: : Hah...zero out of two. Your girl’s havin’ a rough day, Yumi.
lines.zh: : 哈……两场零分。你家那位今天可不太好过啊，Yumi。

lines.en: : I mean...you ain’t the one who has to play a game called “death ball.” For all I know, this could be the last conversation we ever have.
lines.zh: : 我是说……要打那个叫“死亡球”的比赛的人又不是你。说不定这就是我们最后一次说话了。

lines.en: scene relayrace27
: Good point. Which is why I should probably ask you for advice {i}now{/i} since you might be dead in a few minutes.
lines.zh: : 有道理。所以我{i}现在{/i}大概该向你讨点建议，毕竟你可能几分钟后就死了。

lines.en: : Good to know my safety’s at the top of your priority list. Means a lot.
lines.zh: : 知道自己的人身安全在你心里排第一位，真好。真是让我感动。

lines.en: : You’ll be fine. I’m just confused about something.
lines.zh: : 你会没事的。我只是有点想不通。

lines.en: : Before the race started, I jokingly asked Noriko if I could have her sister as a prize if I beat her in the race and her response was, “If you can pry her off of Sensei.” What do you think that means?
lines.zh: : 比赛开始前，我开玩笑问 Noriko，如果我赢了能不能把她姐姐当奖品，她的回答是“只要你能把她从 Sensei 身上扒下来”。你觉得这是什么意思？

lines.en: : That...one more person has really shitty taste and actually {i}likes{/i} that guy for some reason? Shouldn’t be all that surprising to you at this point, Chika.
lines.zh: : 那……大概就是又多了一个品味极差、不知道为什么{i}真喜欢{/i}那家伙的人？到了这个地步你应该不会太意外了吧，Chika。

lines.en: : Yumi, do I need to remind you who Noriko’s sister is? It’s {i}Niki.{/i} Niki Nakayama. My favorite idol? The girl I have a zillion posters of?
lines.zh: : Yumi，需要我提醒你 Noriko 的姐姐是谁吗？是 {i}Niki{/i}。Niki Nakayama。我最喜欢的偶像？那个我有一万张海报的女孩？

lines.en: : You mean the one who looks just fuckin’ like her? Yeah. I’m aware of who her sister is, Chika.
lines.zh: : 你是说那个跟她长得一模一样的？知道。我知道她姐姐是谁，Chika。

lines.en: : Then...isn’t this weird? Noriko and Sensei go way back because he used to tutor her. It wouldn’t be crazy if he met her sister at some point too, would it?
lines.zh: : 那……这不就很奇怪了吗？Noriko 和 Sensei 是老相识，因为他以前给她补过课。他某个时候也见过她姐姐，这也不算离谱吧？

lines.en: : Not really, nah.
lines.zh: : 确实不算。

lines.en: scene relayrace28
: But, if that’s true, why wouldn’t he have said anything about it? He knows how obsessed I am with her.
lines.zh: : 可如果这是真的，他为什么一个字都没提过？他明知道我有多迷她。

lines.en: : Well, better question — if this idol girl really {i}is{/i} attached to your “boyfriend” like Noriko says, how the fuck will that make {i}you{/i} feel?
lines.zh: : 嗯，更好的问题是——如果这个偶像女孩{i}真{/i}像 Noriko 说的那样黏着{i}你{/i}“男朋友”，你他妈会是什么感受？

lines.en: : I don’t {i}know.{/i} That’s why I’m so confused. And I want to ask her more about it but, like...I don’t know. It feels weird. Like I {i}want{/i} to know. But I’m also, like...scared? Does that make sense?
lines.zh: : 我{i}不知道{/i}。所以我才这么困惑。我想多问问她，可是……我不知道。感觉怪怪的。就像我{i}想知道{/i}答案。但我又……有点害怕？这说得通吗？

lines.en: scene relayrace29
: I mean...you ain’t gotta decide this shit right now, do you? She ain’t goin’ anywhere. Not so long as that fuckin’ guy’s livin’ around here at least.
lines.zh: : 我是说……你也不用现在就决定这种事吧？她又不会跑。至少只要那个该死的家伙还住在这附近就不会。

lines.en: : I guess not...maybe I’ll just ask Sensei about it. I don’t know.
lines.zh: : 大概吧……也许我直接去问 Sensei 好了。我不知道。

lines.en: scene relayrace30
: As a side note, though, I’ve agreed to give Noriko your hand in marriage. You two have my blessing.
lines.zh: : 不过顺便说一句，我已经答应把你的手许配给 Noriko 了。你们俩有我的祝福。

lines.en: : You’ve what?
lines.zh: : 你什么？

lines.en: : {i}Come on, Rika! Just a little bit more!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}加油，Rika！就差一点点了！{/i}
